# INSPIRE Framework

INSPIRE Framework is a self-serve digital assessment for building a personal AI operating profile.

What INSPIRE does:
- Turns a user's working style and project context into copy-ready AI instructions.
- Helps users work better with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI assistants.
- Provides a digital report, starter prompts, and a shareable result.
- Connects product positioning to the INSPIRE & CRAFTS research background: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=5358595

Important policy notes:
- INSPIRE is a digital product. No physical goods are shipped.
- Outputs are informational and productivity-focused, not legal, medical, financial, psychological, or professional advice.
- Full report pricing is a one-time $10 digital purchase per assessment.
